sources.entry: Sheer - Brings the macOS 26-style transparent menu bar to macOS 15, letting the wallpaper show through with a faint legibility gradient. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/AzurLiu/sheer) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: Sheer is a free, open-source macOS 15 Sequoia utility that removes the frosted menu bar background so the wallpaper shows through, mimicking the macOS 26 look.
summary.what_it_does: Sheer draws a click-through overlay that removes the frosted background of the macOS 15 menu bar, so the wallpaper runs to the top edge of the screen. It paints a faint gradient behind the menu titles, which is stronger only where the wallpaper needs it, and redraws the menu titles at native size and position using the Accessibility API. Clicks pass through to the real menu bar. It reads still and Dynamic wallpapers from their files and uses Screen Recording to snapshot live wallpapers such as Sequoia. The bar slides with Spaces, Mission Control, unlock and auto-hide, and it updates when the wallpaper changes. The README says it sends no data and checks GitHub once a day for a new version number; it does not auto-install updates.
use_cases: make the macOS menu bar transparent on Sequoia
get the macOS 26 menu bar look without upgrading
show wallpaper behind the menu bar
keep macOS 15 while using the newer menu bar style
how_to_run: Download Sheer.zip from the latest release and unzip it.
Move Sheer.app to the Applications folder.
Open Sheer; if blocked, allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway (or run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Sheer.app).
Grant Accessibility permission (required); grant Screen Recording only for live wallpapers.
Build from source: git clone the repo, cd sheer, ./build.sh, then open build/Sheer.app.
stack: ScreenCaptureKit or Screen Recording API (named as Screen Recording permission)
notable: Places a click-through window between the system menu bar and status items, so clicks still reach the real bar
Reads Dynamic wallpaper files so frames change with the sun, matching the desktop
Mirrors live wallpapers such as Sequoia from the screen, including unlock animation
Localized in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
Detects when a macOS update breaks its private SkyLight call and pauses, leaving the normal menu bar
caveats: Only for macOS 15; on macOS 26 and later it says it isn't needed and quits
Only tested on macOS 15 on a notched MacBook (37 pt menu bar); 24 pt bars and multi-display are derived, not verified
Not notarized by Apple, so Gatekeeper blocks the first launch unless allowed manually
